BiblicalUsage: Na means raw or uncooked, tough flesh, and its only occurrence is at the Passover table. In Exodus 12:9 the people are told not to eat the lamb raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire, head with legs and all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God cares about the details of obedience, even down to how the lamb is cooked; the Passover was not a suggestion, and the roast was part of the remembering.
